digest.component_or_area: ticket write flow (create/edit) and plan-review admission guard
propositions: The description character limit reads from a single config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) shared by the plan-review admission guard and the new save-time warning to ensure single-sourcing.

When a ticket is created or edited with a description exceeding the configured cap and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning is emitted at save time stating the actual length, the cap, and that the claim will require a passing review; the save still succeeds and is unaltered.
The save-time warning is computed after the CREATE/EDIT event is appended and degrades to None on any error, ensuring it can never block or alter a write.

The warning is surfaced through all three caller channels: CLI prints to stderr (stdout stays pure); the library logs via the rebar logger and returns the warning value; MCP returns it as an optional result field (description_warning on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut).
No warning is emitted when the gate is disabled, the ticket type is exempt, or the description is within the cap.
The implementation reuses the existing _plan_review_gate_applies() probe so the warning cannot promise a block that the actual claim gate would not enforce.
